name: nexus-mcp
description: Local code search, call graph and project memory for AI coding agents, in fewer tokens. Runs on your machine. No API keys, no telemetry.
long_description: Nexus-MCP indexes your code on your machine and gives the agent hybrid search, a static call graph, the code of any symbol, and memory that lasts across sessions. It needs uv. The first start downloads the Python packages and the embedding model, so it takes a few minutes. Free and open source under the MIT licence.

tools.name: index
tools.description: Build or refresh the code index of a project.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show whether a project is indexed, and the index health.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find code by meaning or by keyword.

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Get the code of functions and classes by name, with callers and callees.

tools.name: graph
tools.description: Show who calls a symbol and what breaks if it changes.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Find complex code, dead code and code smells.

tools.name: map
tools.description: Give an overview of the project layout.

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Store and recall project decisions and notes across sessions.
